subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT included in 'Operating Surplus'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wages in cash.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

 
• **Operating surplus is the excess revenue generated by a business after deducting operating expenses.**
 
• Rent, profit, and interest are all included in the operating surplus because they are sources of revenue for the business.
 
• Wages
